entities.summary: Benn, born Bencjon Rabinowicz, (1905–1989) was a painter associated with the School of Paris. His early work was mostly figurative; much of his later work is inspired by the Bible, particularly the Book of Psalms. Benn was a painters & sculptors from Białystok (1905-04-19, Białystok–1989). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
